verdict.rationale: Shopify Agentic Commerce ships a developer CLI (@shopify/ucp-cli) and hosted MCP servers, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics collection, or any opt-out control. The cart attribution fields (utm and click_id) and agent-profile identification are a related but different feature and earn no credit here.
